title: IRS TYPE REAR AXLE SHAFT

content.description: Exploded view diagram of IRS Type Rear Axle Shaft showing components from drive shaft through rear brake assembly. Components are arranged from left to right showing: Drive Shaft, Rear Axle Shaft Flange, washers, Inner Oil Seal, Inner Bearing, Inside Bearing Outer Race, Spacer, Outer Bearing, Outer Oil Seal, Rear Axle Shaft, Outside Bearing Outer Race, Disc Rotor, and Rear Brake assembly.
